Constraint 59 present at line 1146 of mcp-server constraints.md. Constraint 32c updated in personas constraints.md at line 97.

Constraints in both manifest files are high quality — rationale + anti-pattern + correct pattern structure, consistent with the constraint documentation gold standard. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: Regex `\|\s*\`${toolName}\`\s*\|` is correctly constructed and handles Markdown table column-spacing drift. The guard is precise: it won't false-positive on tool names that appear in prose (only in table cell position between pipes).

Non-blocking: toolName is interpolated into new RegExp() without escaping special regex metacharacters. All current note_only tool names are [a-z_] only (e.g. ledger_help), so no risk today. Defensive improvement: add toolName.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') before interpolation to future-proof against tool names with dots or other special chars.
Constraint 59 and updated Constraint 32c both follow the ideal documentation structure (rationale + anti-pattern + correct pattern). Consistent with the Gold Nugget template noted in WP-001 review.
Developer's suggestion to add --check to CI/pre-commit (medium priority) is well-founded: the guard only prevents regression if it is exercised in the development loop, not just ad hoc.
